svg.title: White/Black Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and interpretive screen colors. Shaped parallelogram support with a white curved field and black upper-right wedge. Gray surrounding photo background is wall, not a painted rectangular ground. Painted white is retained. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/66184; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
